title: Tickers that beat their sector average
statementMd:
List tickers whose total return (last close vs first close, in percent, 2 decimals) beat the average total return of tickers in the same sector. Show symbol, sector, return_pct.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `sector`, `return_pct`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compute return per ticker first, then window `AVG` per sector.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH f AS (SELECT symbol, FIRST_VALUE(close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY trade_date) AS first_close, FIRST_VALUE(close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS last_close FROM prices), r AS (SELECT DISTINCT symbol, 100.0 * (last_close - first_close) / first_close AS ret FROM f), j AS (SELECT r.symbol, t.sector, r.ret, AVG(r.ret) OVER (PARTITION BY t.sector) AS sector_avg FROM r JOIN tickers t ON t.symbol = r.symbol) SELECT symbol, sector, ROUND(ret, 2) AS return_pct FROM j WHERE ret > sector_avg;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
